messages:
Priya Shah: heads-up — nightly change window for model-serving runtime + kernel patch tonight 23:00 PT. We need final customer-facing copy for statuspage + short email/SMS snippets. Also: confirm pinning policy for Dedicated and canary behavior on Hosted. @deploy-bot can you lock the window?

Alex Kim: ack. Scope is runtime bump + kernel micro-patch (no model weights changes), right?

Priya Shah: correct — no model replaces. We'll pin Dedicated to v2.3.1 (no autoswitch). Hosted will get a staged canary (10% traffic for first 15m then 50% for 15m).

Jordan Lee: propose rollback thresholds:
- sustained p50/p95 tail latency > 250ms / 500ms respectively for 5m OR
- error rate > 0.5% for 3m OR
- canary request failures > 1% in 15m
If any hit, automatic canary rollback + paging to oncall.

Alex Kim: +1 on thresholds. Add a pre-rollout smoke: run `curl -sS https://internal-smoke/redwood/health || exit 1` and a small generation check: `python tests/generator_smoke.py --model redwood-v2 --prompt "hello"`

deploy-bot: Scheduled: change_window=2026-03-21T23:00:00-07:00, duration_est=45m, action_id=cf-89123. Will post start/completion updates to #eng-platform and #support. Canary config: 10%@0m -> 50%@15m -> 100%@30m. Pin: Dedicated -> v2.3.1.

Maya (Customer Success): Draft statuspage snippet below — short, neutral tone. Please review/edit.

```
Status: Maintenance scheduled
When: 2026-03-21T23:00 PT (approx 45 minutes)
Impact: Possible brief increase in latency for inference requests (expected 5–15% for <30 minutes). No expected downtime for API, no data loss.
What we're doing: Applying a runtime performance update and security kernel patch to improve stability.

If anything changes we'll post updates here.
```

Priya Shah: this is clear. Need an email/SMS variant for higher-risk customers (SLA tiers). Keep it explicit we expect no data loss and provide a rollback contact.

Maya (Customer Success): Email draft (short):

```
Subject: Scheduled maintenance — inference runtime update (Mar 21)
Body: Hello, we will perform a scheduled maintenance on Mar 21 at 23:00 PT to apply a runtime and kernel update. You may see a brief latency increase for inference requests (expected <30m). No data will be changed or deleted. If you have concerns, reply to this email or contact support@redwood.com.
```

SMS snippet (for critical customers):
`Redwood scheduled maintenance 3/21 23:00 PT. Possible short latency blips. No data loss expected. Contact support if urgent.`

Alex Kim: edit suggestion for statuspage to call out embeddings/batch workloads: "may impact batched embedding jobs (higher token throughput) — small latency bump possible".

Maya (Customer Success): updated statuspage snippet with that line.

Jordan Lee: ops checklist (short):
- preflight: ensure canary control group baseline metrics captured (latency, error)
- run smoke commands (see above)
- deploy canary to Hosted (10%)
- monitor 0/5/15/30 minute marks
- if thresholds breached -> trigger rollback via `deploy-bot rollback cf-89123` and page oncall
- post-deploy: run gateway and embedding E2E test suite (`./ci/e2e_embedding.sh`)

Priya Shah: add note: Dedicated customers pinned — do not auto-upgrade. We will send manual ops note to Dedicated owners with per-customer window if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary started (simulation): traffic_split=10% -> 50% scheduled at +15m. Reporting hooks enabled.

Alex Kim: who will publish to Statuspage? Maya or product comms?

Maya (Customer Success): I can publish the statuspage snippet at start and update at completion. Team: handoff to me at T-10m.

Priya Shah: sounds good. @deploy-bot please post a start message 5m before the window and mark the public statuspage entry as "Scheduled Maintenance" at start time, then update to "Monitoring" after completion with a short postmortem note.

deploy-bot: Ack — will post: `START: Scheduled maintenance cf-89123` at T-5m, `COMPLETE: cf-89123` at end, and `POSTMORTEM PENDING` if any rollback triggered.

Alex Kim: one more edit for email — add support phone for SLAs: +1-800-555-0123 for critical incidents.

Maya (Customer Success): added. Final copy below (statuspage + email + SMS) — I'm good to publish.

Priya Shah: approved. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you see the start post.

Alex Kim: :thumbsup: 

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: 

Maya (Customer Success): :thumbsup:
